# Side-view occlusion vs V: `lowlr_8k` (generated by `vl.side_occlusion`)

Validation `side_1` at 1 fps (4,451 frames). Occlusion proxy: fraction of the 112x112 training crop differing from the repo's median image by > 40 (see module docstring). Mean 0.086, median 0.073, 90th pct 0.152.
